The '''Republic Security Cordon''' was a line of demarcation that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] drew around the inner portions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref> by [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]<ref name="1032 BBY">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}} is presented as an [[in-universe]] [[Astrography|cartographical]] survey and field report compiled shortly before the [[Raid on Oranessan|commencement]] of [[Operation Influx]], which {{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_influx/index.html|text=''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx''|int=Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx}} dates to [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].</ref> and outside which it deactivated its network of [[Communications relay/Legends|hyperspace relays]].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />
